site._fsr: Calculated off the plans of 10 November, gross floor area as the LEP counts it (inside the external walls; lifts, stairs, plant and balconies out). The tower, levels 3 to 13: the enclosed outline 41.6 × 20.5 m less its two slots and two corner cut-outs is 793 m², less lifts, stairs and risers (30 m²) and the external walls' thickness (42 m²), about 720 m² a floor, 7,930 m² over 11 floors. Levels 1 and 2: enclosed 47.5 × 20.5 m less the slots is 932 m², less core and walls about 860 m² a floor, 1,720 m². The ground floor is taken at 60 % of the lot, 840 m², its plan not seen. 10,490 m² over the 1,396 m² site is 7.5:1. The plans' own GFA schedule should replace it.

tower._: The SSDA plans as marked up on 10 November 2026 (Fuse Architects, 2613; sheets 105 and 108): the ground floor over the lot; levels 1 and 2 held 3 m off Crown Lane (6 m from its middle), 11 apartments a floor; the tower one footprint from level 3 to the top, 6 m off Crown Lane (9 m from its middle), 3 m off Riley Street, Stanley Lane and 66-68 Riley Street, with a slot cut into each long face where the corridor ends, 8 apartments a floor. `podium` counts the storeys under the tower, the ground floor with them; `podiumSetbacks` holds the podium's upper levels off a street; `steps`, where a tower has them, push it further back from a storey up (storeys counted from the ground floor as 1); `levelZero` names the levels as the plans do, GF then L1. `units` lays the apartments out face by face, east and west from the north end and south from the east end, each as [name, width in metres, corner flag where it also has windows or a balcony on that end wall]; a null name is a stretch without an apartment, and with a third figure a slot that many metres deep cut into the tower there.
